stage: branch of withdrawal (so sor sdud pa)
description: Ten signs appear in order in the practice of withdrawal by night and by day — smoke, mirage, fireflies, lamp, blaze, moon, sun, darkness, lightning, drop — as empty forms, not to be grasped.
In charnel grounds and haunted places fear, terrifying apparitions and the sense of being attacked by spirits arise; the practice is to look for the one who is afraid and rest in emptiness.
Fearlessness in frightening places, spirits becoming friendly, clinging to the body falling away and illnesses pacified.
While reciting the Perfection of Wisdom, at its teaching on māras, Machig understood its meaning directly and self-clinging fell away (the tradition's account).
Distant, near and uncertain signs of death — in body, dreams, pulse and urine — by which the physician judges whether an illness can be treated.

Restlessness, sleeplessness, sighing, dizziness and a wandering mind as signs of disturbed rlung, the mount of the mind; Tibetan meditation teachers also warn that forced concentration can disturb rlung (low confidence as to textual source).
